pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Notion pricing in 2026 has four tiers: Free ($0), Plus ($10 per user/month), Business ($20 per user/month), and Enterprise (custom)… Full Notion AI is built into the Business plan… with Free and Plus limited to a capped trial"

sources.title: Notion Pricing 2026: Free, $10 Plus, $20 Business per User

plans.name: Business
plans.quota: Full Notion AI incl. Notion Agent

nl.tagline: Werkruimte voor notities, wiki's en projecten met ingebouwde AI
nl.description: Notion combineert documenten, wiki's, databases en projectbeheer in één werkruimte. Met Notion AI (volledig in het Business-plan) vat je pagina's samen, schrijf je teksten, notuleer je meetings en zet je agents in voor terugkerend werk.
bestFor: Teamkennis en documentatie op één plek
notFor: Wie alleen een losse AI-chat zoekt
limitations: Volledige AI alleen in het Business-plan

en.tagline: Workspace for notes, wikis and projects with built-in AI
en.description: Notion combines documents, wikis, databases and project management in one workspace. With Notion AI (fully included in Business) you summarise pages, draft text, take meeting notes and use agents for recurring work.
bestFor: Team knowledge and documentation in one place
notFor: People who only want a standalone AI chat
limitations: Full AI only on the Business plan
